steps.content: The stone path. Lush shrubs. Wood-and-stone houses. The distant spire. Norma is back.

As she turns over her experience in that anomalous space, a thread of inspiration begins to unravel. She takes out her laptop and lays her recent movement data alongside the readings from the monitoring models she stationed nearby. The result is astonishing.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...A second data set?! With my identity, my trajectory, duplicated and perfectly synchronized?
She shakes her head and launches into rapid typing. Across the screen, the scrambled numbers begin to fall into place.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: I need more samples. With enough data... I can trace everything back to the <color=#fb9259>source</color>, even within a Mania field.
She lifts her hand, conjures a beacon with her ability, and drives it into the earth.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Beginning environmental analysis. Hopefully, the situation won't continue to deteriorate.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: So... that shadow back then. Who was it?
The words die on her lips as her computer blares an urgent alert.
Hey, stop, stop! Don't say that. Us Sinners don't get affected by luck that easily—Ow!
Norma follows the sound, edging closer with caution.
